record.title: New Generation Artificial Intelligence Development Plan
record.original_title: 新一代人工智能发展规划
record.issuing_body: State Council of the People's Republic of China

english_version.by: DigiChina, Stanford University (translators Graham Webster, Rogier Creemers, Elsa Kania, Paul Triolo)

record.summary: China's State Council national plan for AI development to 2030, in three steps. It sets goals of building a system of AI laws, regulations, ethical norms and policies and an AI security assessment and control capability, and tasks on liability and traceability rules, safety management rules for autonomous driving and service robots, risk assessment, a two-tier regulatory structure, testing platforms and safety certification.
record.notes: Dated 8 July 2017 on the document; published on the government portal on 20 July 2017. Sets milestones for 2020, 2025 and 2030. Mainly an industrial and R&D plan; the governance content is in the guarantee measures (laws and ethical norms, security supervision and assessment).
record.scope_note: A national AI development strategy with a mainly industrial and research focus; its sections on laws and ethical norms and on AI security supervision and assessment give it safety and risk-governance content, so it is included as China's flagship AI plan.

verification.note: Stored copy of the State Council page on gov.cn gives the title, number and dates; the English title is a rendering of the Chinese title, based on the Stanford DigiChina translation, which is a third-party translation.

judgment.status_reasoning: A plan issued by the State Council with targets to 2030; nothing in the stored text or elsewhere shows it withdrawn or replaced, so it is current and non-binding policy guidance (a plan sent to departments for implementation).
judgment.scope_reasoning: Borderline strategy: mainly industrial, with guarantee measures on AI law, ethics and security supervision (General rule: strategy with some safety content is in with a scope_note).

open_questions: No English official text found among stored sources; English title is a rendering.
